i_instructions.statement: Triggered by login request. Action: Validate OTP and enforce RBAC device limits. Check: Verify OTP matches secure vault and device count is under limit. Bound: Allow up to 3 OTP retry loops before locking the profile.
i_instructions.trigger: Investor submits a login request with an OTP
i_instructions.action: Validate OTP and enforce RBAC device limits
i_instructions.check: Verify OTP matches secure vault and device count is under limit
i_instructions.bound: Allow up to 3 OTP retry loops before locking the profile

user_role.persona: Retail investor signing in to the portal
user_role.authority: May access only their own profile and holdings

task.goal: Authenticate the investor within 3 attempts or lock the profile
task.method: Bounded OTP verification with an independent RBAC policy check
steps: Action Step: compare OTP and compute device limits
Fixed Check: evaluate otp_match and policy_violation
Loop or Resolve: retry up to 3 times, then authenticate or lock

context.background: Investor portal for a fictional fund (Alpha Dynamics Ltd)
context.history: Device limits were introduced after credential-sharing incidents

a_automation.action_step: Compare provided OTP against Auth_MCP memory and calculate device fingerprint limits.
a_automation.acceptance_check: Programmatically evaluate if otp_match == True AND active_devices <= max_device_limit.
a_automation.srim_metadata: FastMCP_Execution_Engine with PostgreSQL JSONB state in investor_profiles

state_handoff_file.description: Log iteration_pass, device fingerprint used, OTP boolean match evidence and final access scope.

o_outcome.success_criteria: OTP matches and no RBAC policy violation within 3 attempts

ui_updates: Status: Verifying -> Looping [Pass 2/3]: Incorrect OTP -> Authenticated
database_updates: Update investor_profiles with failed attempts or new active session state
alerts: Notify platform ops on account lockout (Escalation)
